title: Sum, PNA, Ungated-Moment, and CAMA Baselines on rel-stack/user-engagement + Sum on rel-trial/study-outcome
summary: Demo notebook that loads pre-computed results from an experiment comparing 5 GNN aggregation methods (Sum, Mean, PNA, Ungated Moment, CAMA) on rel-stack/user-engagement (25 runs: 5 methods x 5 seeds). The notebook demonstrates the CAMA forward pass with numpy, re-runs Cohen's d with bootstrap 95% CIs and paired t-tests, analyzes effective rank of representations, and produces 3 visualizations: validation AP bar chart, Cohen's d forest plot, and effective rank vs performance scatter. Key finding: Sum matches CAMA with no significant difference (p=0.284).
